description:
About our company:

We are a company in the automotive industry, committed to manufacturing excellence and technological innovation.

The Quality System Engineer is the primary owner of the Quality Management System (QMS) within the assigned Trim plants. This role ensures that the Trim plant's quality processes comply with applicable standards (IATF 16949, customer-specific requirements), coordinates all audit activities, drives continuous improvement, and supports the central quality strategy led by the Head of Global Quality.

 Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Management System

•        Maintain, update, and continuously improve the plants-level QMS in accordance with IATF 16949 and Matikon central standards

•        Ensure all quality procedures, work instructions, and documentation are current and controlled

•        Drive alignment with the central quality system as part of the Trim–Kinematics integration initiative

•        Monitor KPIs defined by the Global Quality team and report plant performance in the central dashboard

2. Management Review

•        Coordinate and prepare the plant's Management Review meetings (agenda, data collection, presentation)

•        Track and follow up on action items arising from Management Reviews

•        Ensure Management Review outputs are documented and submitted to the central quality team.

 3. Audit Coordination & Management

•        Plan, schedule, and coordinate all internal, external (customer), and third-party audits (IATF 16949, VDA 6.3, customer-specific)

•        Serve as the main contact for auditors during on-site visits

•        Prepare audit documentation, manage findings, and drive timely closure of corrective actions (8D / CAPA)

•        Conduct and support internal process and system audits.

4. Customer Quality Interface

•        Support customer-specific quality requirements (e.g., Mercedes-Benz CSR compliance)

•        Monitoring the customer escalations in 4 plants

•        Participate in APQP/PPAP activities for new product launches in collaboration with the central APQP team

 

5. Cross-Plant Standardization

•        Actively contribute to Matikon' s quality integration program (standardizing)

•        Share best practices and participate in cross-plant quality working groups

•        Support implementation of centrally defined tools, templates, and processes

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

•        Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field

Experience

•        Minimum 3–5 years of experience in quality management within the automotive supply industry

•        Proven experience with IATF 16949 implementation and surveillance

•        Hands-on experience with audit coordination (internal and external)

•        Experience with OEM customer requirements (Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Stellantis, or similar preferred) 

Technical Skills

•        Strong knowledge of core quality tools: FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, 8D

•        Familiarity with VDA standards (VDA 6.3 process audit preferred)

•        Experience with APQP / PPAP processes

•        Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with quality management software is an advantage

Soft Skills & Language

•        Strong organizational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams

•        Clear and professional communication with internal stakeholders and external auditors/customers

•        Results-oriented mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

•        Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within an international team

•        English: professional working proficiency (required for central reporting and cross-plant communication)

•        German and/or Romanian: advantageous depending on plant location

What We Offer:

•        A key role within a growing, internationally integrated automotive supplier

•        Direct collaboration with the Head of Global Quality and the central quality team

•        Opportunity to actively shape the company-wide quality integration program

•        A stable, long-term position with a structured handover from the outgoing incumbent

•        Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
